exposure: Conception method (spontaneous, controlled ovarian hyperstimulation [COH], or in vitro fertilization [IVF])
cohort: Pregnant women hospitalized at a single tertiary care center between January 2011 and May 2018 for induction of labor with FC
finding: While unadjusted analysis showed an association between fertility treatments and cesarean delivery, adjusted analysis did not support this finding.
mod_finding: Patients who conceived by COH and IVF had significantly higher cesarean section (CS) rates compared to those who conceived spontaneously.
